Or pass email to have a 6-digit code emailed, then call again with email and otp to get a session key (new emails are signed up and also get their api_key). Send

tools.name: shorten_url
tools.description: Shorten a long URL and get a memorable b59.link short URL. Optionally specify a custom slug. Returns the short URL and a stats URL.

tools.name: generate_qr
tools.description: Generate a trackable QR code for a URL. Creates a b59.link short URL at the same time so scans are counted. Returns the short URL, a stats URL, and the QR code as a base64-encoded PNG.

tools.name: create_tracker
tools.description: Create a free page-view tracker for a website. Returns the tag image URL and ready-to-paste snippets for the site's pages, plus the stats URL where views, visitors, pages and referrers are shown. When signed in, the tracker belongs to the account; otherwise keep the manage_token to claim it later.

tools.name: get_stats_url
tools.description: Get the stats page URL for anything b59.link tracks: a slug or short URL, the destination URL of a short link or QR code, a tracker id or tag URL, or any page URL / domain that has a tracker tag. Stats themselves are viewed on b59.link; this returns where.

tools.name: lookup_url
tools.description: Check whether a URL already has a b59.link short URL. Handles variations: http/https, www prefix, trailing slash. Returns the existing short URL and QR code if found.

tools.name: make_qr_image
tools.description: Make a QR code image for any text (URL, Wi-Fi string, phone, email, plain text) without creating a short link. Supports colors, size and SVG. Returns the image plus a permanent image URL that can be embedded with . Use generate_qr instead when scans should be counted.

tools.name: watch_printed_links
tools.description: Watch up to 25 printed links (QR codes on menus, short links on flyers, posters, packaging, cards). Checks each one now and then once a day, and records the whole redirect chain. A link is flagged when it dies (fails twice, 6 hours apart), lands somewhere new, lands on a QR or short-link vendor's 'd

tools.name: get_watch_report
tools.description: Get the state of every link in a printed-link watch: working, dead, moved, deactivated page, redirect changed or certificate expiring, what changed since the first check, the latest redirect chain and the last 30 days.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "auth" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: auth, shorten_url, create_tracker, get_stats_url, lookup_url · Private data: watch_printed_links · Public sink: auth, make_qr_image · Destructive: watch_printed_links.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: auth, shorten_url, create_tracker, get_stats_url, lookup_url · Private data: watch_printed_links · Public sink: auth, make_qr_image · Destructive: watch_printed_links

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "auth" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
